settings.voicemail_policy_title: How to Reach Us by Phone
settings.voicemail_policy_text:
No phone calls are accepted.
For everyone’s protection, all communication must be in writing.
Written records help prevent misunderstandings and ensure accurate support.

When texting or emailing, please clearly include:
• Which website you are contacting us from
• Why you are messaging
• How we may be able to help

Messages without identification may be filtered as spam.
Solicitation is automatically marked as spam.

Orders enter processing within 9 business hours, and we respond as quickly as possible during support hours.
settings.voicemail_response_time: We return all voicemails within 4 hours during business hours.
settings.important_note_1_richtext: Support in U.S. only during EST hours.
settings.important_note_2_richtext: Check spam if no reply; use social media for urgent issues.
settings.single_operator_note: Note: All inquiries are handled by a single operator.
